In this video we cover:
Green Hydrogen: Hype vs Reality
This video looks at hydrogen’s rise as a clean fuel and why progress is slower than expected. Most hydrogen still comes from fossil fuels, making it far from truly green. The IEA report highlights inefficiencies, weak demand, and project cancellations. China leads with cheaper production, while India pushes policies and auctions to build its own green hydrogen industry.
